title: Atomic Acres-owned Quality Graphics Arena Aesthetic Overhaul
creator: Atomic Acres project / Jigglyclaw
inspirationBoundary: Original early-2010s near-future military-suburb atmosphere only. No copied commercial map geometry, meshes, textures, logos, UI, names, or audio.

determinism.command: npm run author:blender-arena && npm run assets:compress:quality
determinism.note: Rebaked at Pass 81 from the re-derived spec (HF-383c), then rebaked again after HF-383-cover-index-regression was FIXED rather than merely recorded. The generator used to select authored large cover by literal COVER_LAYOUT array index (4/5/6/7); HF-383b removed two leading entries, so indices 6 and 7 stopped existing and the service skip and generator trailer were never BUILT - not merely unlabelled. The exporter now publishes AUTHORED_LARGE_COVER_ANCHORS and the generator branches on the anchor's id, matching how src/map.ts and src/environment-assets.ts already key it, so authoredLargePhysicalCoverAssets is back to 4 and all four ids are present in the shipped bytes. Reproducibility is semantic rather than byte-identical across Blender authoring runs; triangle count is reproducible for a given spec.
